verdict.rationale: Working Copy's manual documents a built-in Repository Agent, a conversational AI assistant you can ask to browse files, search content, read and modify files, commit, pull and push. That covers the core git workflow through natural language, and AI-suggested commit messages add to it. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the agent's scope and limits (e.g. branching, rebase or conflict resolution via conversation), details on the model or provider behind it, and any independent or hands-on corroboration that the agent works as described.
